items.q: Is the online image editor free to use?
items.a: Yes, our image editor is 100% free with no hidden fees, watermarks, or subscription requirements. All premium editing tools are available at no cost.

items.q: Are my photos uploaded to your servers?
items.a: No. SafeTools uses advanced browser technology to process all image edits locally on your device. Your photos never leave your computer or smartphone.

items.q: Does this editor work on mobile devices?
items.a: Yes, the editor is fully responsive and optimized for both iOS and Android browsers. You can crop, resize, and edit photos directly on your phone.
We support a wide range of formats including PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP, SVG, GIF, BMP, AVIF, TIFF, and even professional formats like HEIC and PSD for basic viewing.

items.q: Can I remove backgrounds with this tool?
items.a: Yes, we offer an AI-powered background removal tool within the editor that allows you to isolate subjects and create transparent backgrounds instantly.
